method: For every declared contract, run one complete fixture and one fixture for each required field removed. Any missing field must return the item to the problem or project library; a complete declaration may only proceed to professional and field review.
claim_boundary_zh: 合成排演只证明缺字段样例会被本地规则阻断，不证明任何场地、人员、设备、预算、服务、审批或公共成效已经通过现场验证。
claim_boundary_en: The synthetic rehearsal proves only that local rules block fixtures with missing fields. It does not prove any site, staff, device, budget, service, approval or public outcome in the field.
